primary_task: SOP-defined pre-run setup and material-connection support
action: book site-local qualified staffing availability for a future service window
observation_rule: Use only record versions with known_at <= decision time; retain earlier versions and never backfill future corrections into the earlier controller view.
progress_view: recorded task events; no exact continuous remaining work

record_envelope.revision: monotone revision within a record; retain prior versions
record_envelope.event_at: event occurrence or booking creation timestamp, not future scheduled time
record_envelope.known_at: timestamp this version became available to the controller

record_types.name: task_booking
record_types.restriction: Future appointments are usable only if their booking version was already known. Actual future arrival/completion is not a booking.

record_types.name: staff_request
record_types.restriction: Requested staffing is not evidence of acceptance or delivery. No arbitrary fractional crews.

record_types.name: staff_acceptance
record_types.restriction: Acceptance is not actual attendance. A revision does not erase existing obligations.

record_types.name: resource_status
record_types.restriction: Unknown is permitted. Do not substitute a hidden simulator causal-blocking label.

record_types.name: task_event
record_types.restriction: No future completion timestamps, exact remaining work or latent response coefficients. Unfinished observations are censored.

record_types.name: staff_delivery
record_types.restriction: Use recorded availability time, not retroactively reconstructed timesheets. Paid presence is not necessarily productive task service.

record_types.name: cost_record
record_types.restriction: Forecasts require a separate label. Analysis-only future totals are not immediate controller observations or rewards. Avoid double counting commitment and settlement.

excluded_observations: latent service-response regime and change time
exact continuous remaining manual work without an independently validated measurement
future unbooked demand and schedule revisions
future actual staff attendance and future task completion
retrospective costs or outcomes not yet available
employee names, patient names and direct clinical identifiers

domain_inputs.evidence_needed: process-owner/SOP definition including crew, equipment, materials and permitted windows
whether interruption or parallel teams are permissible; conservative default is no preemption
integer crew/slot or justified aggregate hours; no continuous default
cutoff, accepted availability and cancellation policy
site-local capacity, shared equipment or qualified travel/notice constraints if a shared pool exists
example record versions with event_at and known_at including blocked and censored work
event/roster data and causal assumptions; not an automatic linear hours-to-output multiplier
empirical evidence or an explicitly hypothetical ex-ante sensitivity range
staffing, cancellation, switching and delay definitions without importing clinical benefit or monetary units
accounting for unfinished work and accepted commitments beyond the horizon
operationally justified target chosen before scenario screening

execution_preconditions: Resolve every domain input with source/version and domain review; do not interpret null as a synthetic default.
Verify feasible staffing leverage and a temporally valid observation interface.
Review and approve a separate prospective protocol under the locked change-control plan.
Do not assume the current synthetic queue is an operational calibration or an RL-positive scenario.
